cases.name: Emily H. Lu (盧秀行)
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "she was born in Taipei, Taiwan. In childhood she formed many loving memories with her grandmother and established friendships with her schoolmates that she nurtured her entire life. Her commitment to education paid off, earning her a spot in Tamkang University where she received her Bachelor of Science in Accounting in 1972. She further went on to earn her second Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the University of Tennessee in 1988.

She was introduced to an American G.I. named Jerry who would become her husband in 1975. She then emigrated to the United States touching down first in Dugway, Utah and later, built a career in computer science that led her to Northern Virginia. She gave birth to her precious daughter Jenny and poured her life into co-parenting her. Emily was well-known for her generosity of spirit and insisted on providing the very best for her friends and family. She continued to pour her love and generosity into clients as an in-home caregiver for senior citizens during her golden years. In rare moments of free time, she enjoyed working in her garden tending to beautiful flowers."

https://www.dignitymemorial.com/obituaries/falls-church-va/emily-lu-10293828
cases.narrative:
On 7/23/2021, he led police to her body located in a remote area of Dudley Drive and Laurel Crest Drive in Lorton. Officials described Lu's death as a "brutal, vicious murder." A detective wrote in the court documents that they found a knife with its blade broken off in a sink.
